notes: C / R#14: a tf bar trades beyond the prior-day or overnight high / low and a tf close comes back inside -> reversal at market, once per level per session; struct = the sweep extreme
rationale: Stop-run exhaustion at prior-day / overnight extremes (EDGE_SPEC C): price trading beyond the prior-day or overnight high / low fills the stops resting there, and a close back inside shows nobody followed through once they were filled, so the breakout traders are trapped and price reverts.
